title: Lords of Anguish
wikitext:
{{spoiler|[[Guild Wars Nightfall]]}}

The [[Lords of Anguish]] are the four [[demon]]ic overlords who serve [[Mallyx the Unyielding]] and lead the forces of opposition to [[Kormir]]'s newly established rule over the [[Realm of Torment]]. They are based in the [[Domain of Anguish]]:

* The [[Dreadspawn Maw]], in the [[Stygian Veil]]
* [[The Fury]], in [[The Foundry of Failed Creations]]
* [[The Greater Darkness]], in [[Ravenheart Gloom]]
* [[Lord Jadoth]], in the [[City of Torc'qua]]

Each lord will only appear after completing all of the prerequisite quests for the subregion; three appear with an entourage of demons, while the Dreadspawn Maw's death requires killing six [[Smothering Tendrils]]. You can only reach Mallyx, the target of the quest, [[Mallyx the Unyielding (quest)|Mallyx the Unyielding]], by killing the four overlords.
